scripts.env:local: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('.env.local.backup') && fs.existsSync('.env.local')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.local', '.env.local.backup'); if (fs.existsSync('.env.local.local')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.local.local', '.env.local'); console.log('Switched to local Supabase (.env.local.local -> .env.local)');"
scripts.env:remote: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('.env.local.backup') && fs.existsSync('.env.local')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.local', '.env.local.backup'); if (fs.existsSync('.env.local.remote')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.local.remote', '.env.local'); console.log('Switched to remote Supabase (.env.local.remote -> .env.local)');"
